context:
Goal: the code and debts that cite the Card in Hand design point at a file on main.
Problem (rule): draft PR #144, the Duo round 2 Card in Hand design page, never merged. Main still cites it: HandScreen.swift:4-5, DuoHandUITests.swift:2, debt duo-hand-mockup-gaps and decision duo-card-in-hand. Its body says not to merge without your word. It merges cleanly and is docs-only.
Based on (read): git merge-tree is clean; four later rulings (items 24b, 25, 27 and 48) override some of its picks.
Departs from: main has no docs/design/duo-card-in-hand — adds the page, with a top note listing where later rulings override it.

lastAnswer.note: can i get a visual of it

options.gain: The citations resolve, and the only drawing of the stacked poses is on main.
options.how: The page lands on main with a note at the top naming each part a later ruling overrides.
options.label: Merge it as a reference page with an override note
options.lose: A page that's partly out of date, though the note says where.

options.how: The branch moves to an archive name, the PR closes, and the code and records cite the archive.
options.label: Archive it and re-point the citations
options.lose: The source drawing lives only on an archive branch.

ref: draft PR #144 (Duo round 2 Card in Hand design, branch design/duo-round2); HandScreen.swift:4-5; DuoHandUITests.swift:2
reply: The pictures are linked under each option: the design's screens on PR 144's branch, design/duo-round2. Later rulings (items 24 b, 25, 27 and 48) override some of them.
title: The Card in Hand design page (PR #144) never merged, but main cites it. Merge it as a reference?
why: Open debts already depend on it, and the note keeps readers from building the overridden parts.
